_weights._note: w_magic_fear 0.8 because the Lex Cornelia is used against malefici and astrologers are expelled repeatedly. w_religious_rigidity only 0.2 because Roman religion is pluralistic and absorbs new cults readily; it is MAGIC that is criminal, not heterodoxy. w_labour_saving negative because of the Vespasian precedent and cheap coerced labour.
_weights._note_eminence: An autocracy in which prominence is lethal: Sejanus, Seneca, Thrasea Paetus. The higher you rise the fewer people are above you, and every one of them is a threat.
